page.overview:
Who is Jay Limo?

"Jay Limo spent countless nights on the road, criss-crossing the country perfecting his stand-up comedy act before getting his big break performing on the most popular late show in town.

It wasn't long until he was asked to fill in as guest host, and eventually took over the show full time. "

entity.description: "Jay Limo spent countless nights on the road, criss-crossing the country perfecting his stand-up comedy act before getting his big break performing on the most popular late show in town. It wasn't long until he was asked to fill in as guest host, and eventually took over the show full time. He may be a big-time talk show host now, but that hasn't stopped him from spending countless nights on the road, criss-crossing the country, still working to perfect his comedy act."
